questions.question_text: Which organization conducts the Common Recruitment Process (CRP) for Public Sector Banks in India?
options: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
questions.explanation: IBPS is the autonomous body specifically set up to handle the selection of personnel for banks through the Common Recruitment Process.

questions.question_text: Who was the founder Chairman of the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS)?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manmohan Singh served as the first Chairman of the Governing Board of IBPS.

questions.question_text: What is the primary function of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?
questions.explanation: The RBI is the central bank of India and is the sole authority responsible for issuing currency notes.

questions.question_text: The IBPS is registered under which Act?
questions.explanation: IBPS exists as a society registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, and as a public trust.

questions.question_text: Which institution set up the PSS Unit that later became IBPS?
questions.explanation: The Personnel Selection Services (PSS) Unit was part of the National Institute of Bank Management (NIBM) before becoming an independent body in 1984.

questions.question_text: Who was the first Chairman of the IBPS Governing Board?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manmohan Singh served as the first Chairman of the IBPS Governing Board while he was the Governor of the RBI.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the 'Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024'?
options: To prevent organized crime and unfair means
questions.explanation: This Act aims to curb malpractices and unfair means in public examinations conducted by authorized bodies like IBPS.

questions.question_text: Which organization serves as the regulator for the insurance sector in India?
questions.explanation: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) regulates the insurance sector.
